summary: This Mol Labs public report (P16) is a research discussion card proposing an assay to test whether the LKKTETQ actin-binding heptapeptide (derived from thymosin β4) retains HUVEC migration/sprouting activity under a G-actin critical-concentration (Cc) / sequestration condition matched to full-length Tβ4 that abolishes a sequestration-dependent parent readout. The document synthesizes prior literature (Philp, Safer, Van Troys) to frame the gap and defines a pre-registered prediction: LKKTETQ ≥50% of equimolar intact Tβ4 on the same panel under Cc-match. The experiment has NOT been run; the key matched residual H2H result is explicitly UNKNOWN.

content_blocks.title: Claim / Hypothesis Statement
content_blocks.content: On a matched equimolar LKKTETQ vs intact Tβ4 panel with HUVEC migration/sprouting plus pyrene/Cc (or stoichiometric G-actin sequestration): under a G-actin sequestration/Cc condition matched to full-length Tβ4 that abolishes a sequestration-dependent readout for parent Tβ4, LKKTETQ still drives HUVEC migration/sprouting ≥50% of the equimolar intact Tβ4 arm on the same panel. This is framed as a 'sequestration-insufficiency assumption-kill.' Status: NEGATIVE (not yet run). Execution status: NOT_RUN.

content_blocks.title: Scientific Rationale / Mechanism Sketch
content_blocks.content: Full-length Tβ4 is a stoichiometric G-actin sequesterer (Safer 1991). Van Troys (1996) showed that both the N-terminal helix (≈residues 1–16) and the LKKTET motif (17–22) are required for sequestering competence — the motif alone is not the whole sequestering machine. Philp (2003 FASEB) showed synthetic LKKTETQ ≈ parent Tβ4 on HUVEC migration and chick aortic-arch sprouting at ~50 nM, with soluble actin modulating Tβ4 adhesion/sprouting — but without an equimolar LKKTETQ vs Tβ4 pyrene/Cc co-assay on that panel. P16 proposes to score residual LKKTETQ HUVEC migration/sprouting under a G-actin sequestration/Cc condition matched to parent Tβ4 that first abolishes a sequestration-dependent parent readout, on the same equimolar panel.

content_blocks.title: Prior Art Summary
content_blocks.content:
1. PMID 14500546 (Philp 2003 FASEB J): Synthetic LKKTETQ ≈ full-length Tβ4 HUVEC migration and chick aortic-arch sprouting at ~50 nM; motif-truncated peptides inactive; heptapeptide blocks adhesion to Tβ4; soluble actin 5–50 nM inhibits Tβ4 adhesion/sprouting. NOT equimolar Cc/pyrene residual H2H.
2. PMID 12581423 (Philp 2003 Wound Repair Regen): LKKTETQ promotes aged/db/db dermal repair comparable to parent Tβ4. Phenotype ≠ sequestration proof; ≠ residual-under-Cc H2H.
3. PMID 1999398 (Safer 1991): Full-length Tβ4 indistinguishable from platelet Fx as stoichiometric G-actin sequesterer inhibiting polymerization. Parent sequestration prior for Cc-matched condition; no LKKTETQ arm.
4. PMID 8617195 / PMC449934 (Van Troys 1996): N-terminal helix (≈1–16) and LKKTET motif (17–22) both required for actin contact/sequestering competence; motif alone is not the whole sequestering machine. Two-site prior predicting sequestration insufficiency; no HUVEC migration/sprouting panel under Cc match.

content_blocks.title: Baseline Measured vs Unknown
content_blocks.content:
KNOWN (literature): Philp LKKTETQ ≈ Tβ4 HUVEC migration/sprouting (PMID 14500546); Philp dermal repair match (PMID 12581423); Safer full-Tβ4 stoichiometric sequestration (PMID 1999398); Van Troys two-site sequestering map (PMID 8617195).
UNKNOWN: Matched residual-LKKTETQ under parent-matched Cc/sequestration abolishing parent sequestration readout on same HUVEC panel. Soft-complete review: LKKTETQ∩(Cc|pyrene|sequester*)∩Tβ4 = NON-MATCH; LKKTETQ∩HUVEC∩(migration|sprouting)∩(actin|sequester*) = 0; Safer∩LKKTETQ = 0; Van Troys∩HUVEC = 0; pyrene∩LKKTETQ = 0.
PREDICTION: Residual LKKTETQ ≥50% of equimolar Tβ4 arm under Cc match.

content_blocks.title: Proposed Assay Design and Actionable Limitations
content_blocks.content:
Proposed method: propose-assay. Preferred readouts: cell migration/sprouting + pyrene/Cc before animal/human. Optional N-helix+motif variant control. Pre-specified α/N required.
Key limitations:
1. P1–P15 do not prove P16 — P3 left Philp migration match vs Safer/Van Troys sequestration unbridged (no paired Cc co-assay); soft-complete empty ≠ demonstrated residual phenotype.
2. Skip-list distinctness: do not collapse to OpenLabs 8e5ba06c/7db12286 BPC orthosteric dialect or P15 residual-FBXO22; NOT FOXO4×LOF (SERIES_FROZEN).
3. Philp soluble-actin block ≠ Cc-matched residual panel; Safer/Van Troys lack HUVEC residual-under-Cc arm; incomplete Cc match / parent sequestration readout not abolished / incomplete pyrene QC leave the test inconclusive rather than refuted.
Refute condition: LKKTETQ migration/sprouting <50% of equimolar Tβ4 arm under Cc-matched condition where parent sequestration-dependent readout is abolished and pyrene/stoichiometry QC passes.

key_findings: The matched residual LKKTETQ under parent-matched Cc/sequestration H2H experiment has NOT been run (execution_status=NOT_RUN); the key result is explicitly UNKNOWN.
Philp (PMID 14500546) established that synthetic LKKTETQ ≈ full-length Tβ4 on HUVEC migration and chick aortic-arch sprouting at ~50 nM, but without a paired equimolar Cc/pyrene co-assay.

Van Troys (PMID 8617195) showed both the N-terminal helix (≈1–16) and LKKTET motif (17–22) are required for sequestering competence — motif alone is not the whole sequestering machine — predicting sequestration insufficiency of LKKTETQ.
Safer (PMID 1999398) established full-length Tβ4 as a stoichiometric G-actin sequesterer indistinguishable from platelet Fx, but with no LKKTETQ arm.
Philp (PMID 12581423) showed LKKTETQ promotes aged/db/db dermal repair comparable to parent Tβ4, but this is a phenotypic match, not a sequestration proof.

The pre-registered prediction is: under G-actin Cc matched to Tβ4 that abolishes parent sequestration readout, LKKTETQ HUVEC migration/sprouting ≥50% of equimolar intact Tβ4 arm (sequestration-insufficiency assumption-kill).
Soft-complete literature review found zero hits for LKKTETQ∩HUVEC∩(migration|sprouting)∩(actin|sequester*), Safer∩LKKTETQ, Van Troys∩HUVEC, and pyrene∩LKKTETQ.
Estimated time to refute: 4 weeks; kill cost tier: 1 (low cost); vault hold: no.
The document explicitly excludes FOXO4×LOF (SERIES_FROZEN), BPC-157/FBXO22/VEGFR2 orthosteric dialect, and P15 residual-FBXO22 framing as out-of-scope.
